Short answer

To install yt-dlp on Omarchy, open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add yt-dlp. It is a 2.9 MB download (3.1 MB installed), version 2026.10.26-1, licensed Unlicense. A youtube-dl fork with additional features and fixes. Check the project site for current pricing.

Install yt-dlp on Omarchy

A youtube-dl fork with additional features and fixes

The official repository lists this package in Utilities. It was added on 2026-11-12.

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add yt-dlp
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 2026.10.26-1:
    pacman -Qi yt-dlp

Open and use yt-dlp

To see what the package installed, including any commands and desktop entries:

pacman -Ql yt-dlp

Frequently asked questions

How do I install yt-dlp on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add yt-dlp. The download is 2.9 MB and it takes 3.1 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is yt-dlp free?

Check the project site for current pricing. The package is licensed Unlicense.

How do I uninstall yt-dlp?

Run omarchy pkg drop yt-dlp. It removes the package from your system.

What does yt-dlp depend on?

The package declares 2 dependencies: python, nodejs. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is yt-dlp in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as yt-dlp (version 2026.10.26-1) in the official Omarchy package repository. yt-dlp makes it. Project site: https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp.
